entries.0071de1210f50adc: A field in which Phan Vu Investment Corporation and its manufacturing subsidiary manufacture, construct and sell concrete piles in Vietnam.
entries.35b6ac4ddcc51b8e: A field in which Japan Pile purchases steel pipe piles from manufacturers via trading companies, and constructs and sells them. Japan Pile Foundation Industry also handles construction.
entries.652b38a8f405a7a0: A field in which Japan Pile manufactures, constructs and sells products, undertaking foundation work from general contractors, trading companies and agents. Japan Pile Foundation Industry handles construction, and Japan Pile Fujicon and Japan Pile Kanto-Kita Sales handle construction and sales.
entries.7014dd3fe128fee3: A business that manufactures, constructs and sells concrete piles, steel pipe piles and cast-in-place piles in Japan. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥94,902 million. Japan Pile, the core company, undertakes foundation work from general contractors, trading companies, agents and others, and the group companies handle construction and sales.
entries.800e6367cb6153af: A comprehensive foundation construction group centered on the manufacture and installation of concrete piles, carrying out foundation work in Japan and Vietnam.
entries.af27fa4bc1ee1a7f: A business that manufactures, constructs and sells concrete piles in Vietnam. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥21,054 million. Phan Vu Investment Corporation undertakes foundation work from project owners and others, purchases concrete piles from its manufacturing subsidiary to construct and sell them, and the manufacturing subsidiary also sells directly to customers.
entries.c26bfe7251c9295d: A field in which Japan Pile and Takayama Foundation Industry construct and sell cast-in-place piles, with materials supplied by general contractors and others. Japan Pile Foundation Industry also handles construction.
entries.fced9add7d642936: A field in which Shintoku Kogyo manufactures and sells joint fittings for concrete piles and attachment hardware for concrete secondary products.
